M2는 광의통화(넓을광, 뜻의, 통할통, 돈화) - 널리 쓰이는 돈

When the Federal Reserve pumps money into the banking system via overnight repos (repurchase agreements), it means banks are short on cash and need emergency liquidity, so the Fed temporarily lends them money in exchange for high-quality collateral (like Treasury bonds), acting as a crucial backstop to prevent funding stress, stabilize short-term rates, and ensure smooth daily operations, often signaling underlying strains like tight reserves or high Treasury issuance.
